title: How Often to Replan: Reasons, a Cooldown, and Planning From Where the Vehicle Will Be When the Plan Arrives

artifact.note: when to plan again: the remaining path is checked against the latest grid for a blocked point within a look-ahead distance, the vehicle's distance from the path, a period and a changed goal; a cooldown keeps the planner from running every tick (a blocked path may bypass it); and the new plan starts from where the vehicle will be when the plan arrives, not from where it was when planning began
